entries.subject: perf(insights): fix deposit-bonus Risk-tab 57014 timeout via hash/range-join rewrite
entries.body:
The /insights/rewards/deposit-bonus Risk tab (?tab=risk) threw Prisma
57014 (statement_timeout) on EVERY period window, collapsing the
"Suspicious claimant signals" section into TileErrorFallback (caught
failing a Playwright render sweep on live prod).

Root cause: the same unindexed correlated-pairing trap already fixed in
deposit-bonus-analytics.ts (d79c4c91) and the cohort/cap/behavior helpers
(bb1a9e3d). suspicious.ts Flag 1 (withdrewAfterBonus / cash-out abuse)
paired each in-window bonus claimant to a card_withdrawal via JOIN LATERAL
(... LIMIT 1) AND ran a correlated NOT EXISTS wager check per row.
ledger_transactions is ~855k rows, indexed only on id / external_tx_id /
fireblocks_tx_id - NO index on type / user_id / created_at - so both ran a
full Seq Scan PER claimant row (EXPLAIN cost ~120M-130M) -> 57014 timeout on
30d AND all (verified on live prod: even 7d timed out; 1d/3d took 18-20s).
Indexes are off-limits (read-only prod), so the fix is query-shape only:

  - materialise the window's bonus claimants, then the claimants'
    withdrawals and wager events - both scoped to user_id IN
    (bonus_claimants), a tiny user set, so each is ONE table pass with a
    hash semi-join instead of a per-row Seq Scan;
  - range-join claimants<->withdrawals on the 24h window, DISTINCT ON
    (user_id) ORDER BY w.created_at ASC = the old LIMIT 1 first-match;
  - drop paired rows with a wager in [last_bonus, withdrew] via an
    anti-join (NOT EXISTS over the materialised wager set) = the old
    correlated NOT EXISTS, one hash pass.

The withdrawal / wager sets carry NO global date bound (claimant-set
membership already bounds them), so the all-window pairing semantics are
preserved EXACTLY. MATERIALIZED prevents Postgres inlining the CTEs back
into a correlated form. Semantics preserved exactly (same join keys, staff
exclusion, 24h pairing window, first-match-wins, no-wager-between anti-join)
- verified IDENTICAL top-25 output vs the original on the narrow windows
where the original completes (2026-05-28/29, 06-06, 06-11 - 13-25 paired
rows match key-for-key incl. amounts/hours/counts; WITH anti-join also
identical). Drops the query from a >30s timeout to ~0.3-0.6s on live prod.

NOT changed (verified separately, already fast on live prod, no fix needed):
suspicious.ts Flag 2 noWager (EXISTS hash semi-joins, 0.36-0.43s),
Flag 3 sharedFingerprint (0.18-0.19s), and top-spenders.ts (Nested Loop
over the top-25 window_bonus set, 0.67-0.99s).

Defense-in-depth: the risk-tab safeQuery calls now pass
REWARD_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS (matching cap-tab / cohorts-tab / impact-tab) so a
future slow regression degrades to a TileErrorFallback tile instead of
hanging the page.

Verified on live prod data via Playwright + minted admin session against
npm run dev: /insights/rewards/deposit-bonus?tab=risk renders the top-25
table + suspicious-signals section with real data on period=30d AND all
(1.2s each, 0 pageerrors, no error boundary, no TileErrorFallback).
tsc/lint(0 new)/build exit 0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entries.subject: feat(insights/real-numbers): close GGR→P&L waterfall to realized P&L
entries.body:
The GGR breakdown is now a COMPLETE, closing waterfall instead of ending at
NGR. The prior change removed a perceived-fake plug and left the bridge open;
this re-adds the closing legs as EXPLICIT differences of independently-measured
values (never a plug), so the running total closes to the penny at realized P&L.

Rows (each measured or an explicit difference of two measured values):
  • GGR (measured, getCostBreakdown)
  • − Reward & bonus spend → NGR (measured) — GGR-by-game + reward-itemized
    sub-breakdowns kept
  • − Turnover→cash conversion → customer cash margin. VALUE = NGR −
    customerCashMargin, where customerCashMargin =
    getRealizedPnlCustomersExclCreators().pnl (realized P&L of customers-only,
    creators excluded). Presented honestly as "= NGR − customer cash margin
    (both measured)" with the recycling evidence inline (deposits, wager, the
    ~3.5× re-wager multiple, card sell-backs via getCustomerRecyclingDetail).
    Not a cost, not a plug: a basis conversion. Running total lands exactly on
    customerCashMargin.
  • − Creator net cash → Realized P&L. VALUE = customerCashMargin − pnlInclCreators
    (= creatorEffect, the NET real crypto creators took out, not the gross
    program funding). Note clarifies the gross funding is mostly fake/recycled
    session money shown in the Creator program cost panel and already inside
    these cash flows (not double-counted).

Both difference legs are computed from measured endpoints (NOT ngr−creatorEffect−pnl),
so each closes by construction. Added a live "Ties out to realized P&L exactly"
assertion. When the customer-cash read fails the waterfall gracefully ends at
NGR (no fabricated terminus). All values pulled live — no hardcoded figures.

The getRealizedPnlCustomersExclCreators + getCustomerRecyclingDetail helpers
already existed in real-numbers.ts (left after the prior removal); re-imported
and re-wired into the page Promise.all. No gaming SQL hand-rolled. The GGR-by-game
table, reward-itemized table, balance-sheet P&L waterfall, two-scoreboards
section, and creator program cost panel are unchanged.

Verified on live prod data (minted admin session + Playwright render): GGR
+$515,807.90 − reward $133,775.09 − (NGR−customerCash) $285,159.94 − creator
net $53,331.54 = +$43,541.33 realized P&L, ties out to the penny; recycling
evidence (3.5×, $2.3M sell-backs, $917k deposits) renders inline; 0 pageerrors.

entries.subject: perf(insights): fix deposit-bonus Cohorts/Cap 57014 timeouts via hash-join rewrite
entries.body:
The /insights/rewards/deposit-bonus Cohorts tab (cohort comparison +
time-to-claim) and Cap & Ratio tab (biggest-cap-deposits + bonus/deposit
ratio distribution) threw Prisma 57014 (statement_timeout) on EVERY
period window (verified on live prod: 30d, 365d, and even 7d), degrading
those panels to TileErrorFallback.

Root cause: the same unindexed correlated-pairing predicate already fixed
in deposit-bonus-analytics.ts (d79c4c91). These helpers paired each
window deposit to its deposit_bonus via LEFT/INNER JOIN LATERAL (...
balance_before::numeric = balance_after ... LIMIT 1). ledger_transactions
is ~855k rows, indexed only on id / external_tx_id / fireblocks_tx_id —
NO index on the balance columns — so the correlated LATERAL ran a full
Seq Scan PER deposit row (EXPLAIN cost 223M-819M). cohort.ts additionally
ran two correlated retention EXISTS (7d/30d wager) per paired row, each
also a full table scan. Indexes are off-limits (read-only prod), so the
fix is query-shape only:

  - cohort.ts computeCohortComparison: materialise window deposits +
    bonuses + the window+30d wager set into MATERIALIZED CTEs; hash-join
    deposits<->bonuses on (user_id, balance_before = balance_after) within
    the 30s window with DISTINCT ON (deposit id) ORDER BY bonus.created_at
    ASC (reproduces LIMIT 1; LEFT join keeps unpaired = "without"); and
    replace the two retention EXISTS with a single LEFT JOIN to the wager
    set over the 30d range + bool_or of the 7d/30d windows.
  - cohort.ts computeRatioDistribution (both the bucket query and the
    median query): same materialised hash-join pairing (INNER).
  - behavior.ts computeTimeToClaim (bucket + percentile queries): same
    materialised hash-join pairing (INNER).
  - cap-analysis.ts biggestCapDeposits: same, with the cap-equal
    predicate pushed into the materialised bonus CTE.

Lifetime (all) stays capped to 365d on every leg via windowDateFilter-
Capped; the new windowDateFilterCappedTail bounds the cohort wager scan
to window+30d. Semantics preserved exactly (same join keys, staff
exclusion, first-match-wins, LEFT vs INNER identity) — verified IDENTICAL
results vs the original on a 6h window (where the original completes).
Drops every query from a >30s timeout to ~0.2-2s on live prod data.

Defense-in-depth: the cohorts-tab + cap-tab safeQuery calls now pass
REWARD_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS so a future slow regression degrades to a
TileErrorFallback tile instead of hanging the segment (matching
impact-tab.tsx).

npm run dev: overview / cap / cohorts / roi / impact / forecast tabs all
render real data on period=30d AND all (0 pageerrors, no error boundary).

entries.subject: fix(insights/real-numbers): waterfall reward rows showed -$0.00

ggr/ngr/rewardPayouts:

  reward(excl rain) = -max(0, rewardPayouts - ggr + ngr)
  net rain          = -(ngr - (ggr - rewardPayouts))

entries.body:

Deposit Bonus tab) threw Prisma 57014 (statement_timeout) on EVERY
period window, collapsing the whole Rewards Insights page into the
/insights error boundary.

Root cause: getDepositBonusCohortExtras paired each window deposit to
its deposit_bonus via LEFT JOIN LATERAL (... balance_before::numeric =
balance_after ... LIMIT 1). ledger_transactions (860k rows) is only

`cachedCohortRows` is behind `unstable_cache`, whose JSON serialization
turns the `date_trunc(...)::date` Date into an ISO string; the new prod
driver also returns the cast as a string on a miss. The aggregation loop
called `.toISOString()` on it directly. Coerce `row.cohort` to a real

`pnl` is a SELECT-list alias; `ORDER BY pnl::numeric DESC` used the alias
inside a cast expression, which Postgres resolves against INPUT columns,
not the output alias → the column lookup fails. Repeat the aggregate P&L
expression directly in ORDER BY (already numeric, matches the HAVING
clause). P&L derivation (wager − payouts, house POV, creator in-session

fills. Added an `isoDate(Date | string)` helper, applied it to all four

entries.body:

total) on 429/503 with exponential backoff (250ms base) plus jitter,
